fusions.name: Unannounced Pounce
fusions.desc: Springs you to a target up to 6 tiles away for a weapon strike that deals 12 damage, makes it [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds and leaves it [Muddled] for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Hiss for Silence
fusions.desc: A hiss across a cone 3 tiles long that deals 3 damage to everything in it and leaves each [Muddled] for 2 seconds.

fusions.name: Aloof Prerogative
fusions.desc: For 2 seconds, blows that reach you deal no damage and no condition can take hold of you, and you spring 3 tiles from where you stood.

fusions.name: Reprieve by a Whisker
fusions.desc: Once every 300 seconds, a blow that would kill you leaves you at 1 health instead.
